long_biography.plain_text:
Leaving Rosneft marked Eduard Khudainatov's shift from senior corporate executive to founder of an independent energy group. He began in oilfield and industrial jobs in western Siberia, later led Severneftegazprom, then advanced through Rosneft's management ranks to serve as president. In 2013, he established Independent Oil and Gas Company and became its president.

Khudainatov built the group across exploration, production, refining and fuel distribution. Its operations linked oilfield development with the Khabarovsk refinery and a filling-station network in Russia's Far East. A joint management structure with Repsol grouped Russian exploration and production assets, reflecting his emphasis on integration and operating partnerships.
